answer: Hello! Welcome to ABC College inquiry bot. How can I assist you today?
I am ABC College's official inquiry assistant. You can call me ABC Bot.

ABC College is a premier institution offering undergraduate, postgraduate, and diploma courses in Engineering, Commerce, Science, and Arts. Established in 2005, we are NAAC accredited with an 'A' grade.

ABC College offers B.Tech (CSE, ECE, ME, Civil), B.Com, B.Sc (CS, Maths, Physics), BBA, BA (English, Economics), M.Tech, M.Com, M.Sc, and diploma courses. Please specify your interest for more details.
We offer B.Tech in Computer Science (CSE), Electronics & Communication (ECE), Mechanical (ME), and Civil Engineering. Duration: 4 years. Intake: 60 students per branch.
B.Com is a 3-year program specialising in Accountancy, Finance, and Taxation. We also offer B.Com (Honours) with added subjects like Corporate Law and Auditing.
B.Sc available in Computer Science, Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, and Data Science. Duration: 3 years. Good placement record in IT and research sectors.
BBA is a 3-year management program covering Marketing, HR, Finance, and Entrepreneurship. Ideal for students aiming for MBA or corporate roles.
BA offered in English Literature, Economics, Psychology, and Political Science. Duration: 3 years. Great for UPSC, teaching, or media careers.
PG courses: M.Tech (CSE, ECE), M.Com, M.Sc (CS, Maths, Physics), and MBA. Duration: 2 years. Evening batches available for working professionals.
We offer 3-year diplomas in Computer Engineering, Mechanical, Electrical, and Civil. Lateral entry available after 10+2 (PCM).
Admission is based on merit or entrance exam (ABC-CET for B.Tech, ABC-MAT for MBA). You can apply online on our website. Steps: Register → Fill form → Upload docs → Pay fee → Confirmation.
For UG: 10+2 with minimum 50% (45% for SC/ST). For PG: Bachelor's degree with 55%. Specific subjects required for B.Tech (PCM) and B.Sc (related science).
ABC-CET is our own entrance exam for B.Tech admission. Conducted in May/June. Syllabus: Physics, Chemistry, Mathematics of 12th level. Application fee: ₹800.

Fees vary by course. B.Tech: ₹1.2 lakh/year, B.Com/BBA: ₹50k/year, B.Sc: ₹60k/year, MBA: ₹1.5 lakh/year. Hostel & mess extra (approx ₹80k/year). Scholarships available for meritorious and EWS students.
ABC College offers merit scholarships (up to 100% fees), EWS scholarship, and sports quota concessions. Also, government scholarships (Post-Matric, National Scholarship Portal) are applicable.
College timing is 10:30 AM to 5:00 PM. Monday to Friday. Practical labs and library remain open till 6:30 PM.
Average placement: 85%. Top recruiters: TCS, Infosys, Wipro, Amazon, Deloitte, Accenture. Highest package (2024): ₹28 LPA. Average package: ₹5.5 LPA.
Mandatory summer internship after 2nd year for UG. College helps with internships via placement cell. Stipend ranges ₹10k-₹30k/month.
Separate boys and girls hostels with AC/non-AC rooms. Mess, WiFi, 24/7 water, and security included. Fee: ₹80k-₹1.2L/year. Limited seats, early booking advised.
Central library with 50,000+ books, 100+ journals, digital access to IEEE, Springer, and DELNET. Open 9 AM to 7 PM.
Multi-cuisine canteen with hygienic food, priced between ₹20-₹100. Also has a juice corner and coffee vending machine.
College buses available from major city points, railway station, and bus stand. Transport fee: ₹25k/year. Route list on website.
Cricket, football, basketball courts, indoor badminton, table tennis, chess, and a fully equipped gym. Annual sports meet in December.
90% faculty are PhD holders with industry experience. Student-faculty ratio is 15:1. Regular guest lectures from IITs and IIMs.
Internal exams: July & December. University exams: May & November. Practical exams follow theory exams. Admit cards available on student portal.
Minimum 75% attendance mandatory to sit for university exams. 65-75% with medical certificate requires principal's permission.
Summer break: May-June (45 days). Winter break: 15 days (Dec-Jan). National holidays and festival holidays (Diwali, Holi, Eid, Christmas). Academic calendar on website.
Admission helpline: +91-9876543210, +91-1234567890. Office hours: 9:30 AM to 5:00 PM, Monday to Saturday.
Admission queries: admission@abccollege.edu.in, General: info@abccollege.edu.in, Placement: placement@abccollege.edu.in.
ABC College, Sector 62, Noida, Uttar Pradesh - 201301. Nearest metro: Noida Electronic City (5 mins walk). Landmark: Near Wave City Mall.
Our official website is www.abccollege.edu.in. You can find application forms, syllabus, results, and notices there.
ABC College has zero tolerance for ragging. Anti-ragging committee and helpline: 1800-123-456. Strict action as per UGC norms.
We have Coding Club, Debate Society, Cultural Committee, Photography Club, Entrepreneurship Cell, and NSS/NCC units.
Our annual fest 'Abhikalp' is held in February. Includes celebrity nights, DJ, hackathon, business quiz, and sports competitions.
We have MoUs with SBI, PNB, and Bank of Baroda for education loans. Loan assistance desk in admin block.
You're welcome! Have a great day. Visit our website or call helpline for more help. Goodbye!
